basic_info.description: Rare Investment Opportunity in SF's Parkside Neighborhood! 2319-2321 21st Ave, offers an income-generating duplex with an in-law, boasting a prime location half block to Taraval Street to take street car or enjoy many restaurants, parks and library. Safeway is few blocks away, Famous Lincoln High School is walking distance. Couple blocks to 19th Ave to take public transportation to Stonestown Shopping Center or State University. This stunning property features 2 spacious units with formal dining rooms, large east-facing living rooms with morning light, and original details like hardwood floors and fireplaces. With a tenant-occupied 2nd-floor unit providing immediate income and available 3rd floor and in-law offering opportunities for renovation or rental income, this property is ideal for investors seeking to collect rent from multiple units, live in one unit and rent out the others, or renovate for increased rental income. Don't miss this rare opportunity to own a piece of San Francisco's desirable Parkside neighborhood!
